item.title: FÁBIO JALÓ JOINS OLDHAM ATHLETIC ON LOAN
item.description: Barnsley Football Club can confirm the loan departure of Fábio Jaló to Oldham Athletic until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. The 20-year-old joins the Sky Bet League Two outfit to gain further senior experience and continue his development in a competitive environment following his rehabilitation from a knee injury sustained in April 2025. item.title: TOM BRADSHAW JOINS THE REDS
item.description: Barnsley FC are delighted to announce the loan signing of striker Tom Bradshaw from Oxford United, with the forward returning to Oakwell until the end of the 2025/26 season. Bradshaw previously represented the Club between 2016 and 2019, making 93 appearances and scoring 19 goals during his time at Oakwell. item.title: THANK YOU, DAVIS
item.description: Barnsley FC can confirm that forward Davis Keillor-Dunn has completed a permanent transfer to Wrexham AFC for an undisclosed fee. The move sees the 28-year-old depart Oakwell to rejoin the Welsh club, where he previously spent a brief spell earlier in his career.
